name: Lrssn
about: The tokens of the Lrssn design system. Generated by scripts/build.py. Do not edit.

tokens.name: primary-color
tokens.usage: Brand orange: the primary button, the logo files, the underline of the current link and the margin rule. A fill at most once per screen. Never text.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Orange text: the logo on screen, links and text on `primary-soft`.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Apricot tint: text selection, the New badge and the Important callout.

tokens.name: secondary-color
tokens.usage: The cool accent as a fill, a border or a bar: quotes and task-list boxes. Never text.

tokens.name: secondary-text
tokens.usage: Text in the cool accent: topic pills without a colour of their own, and breadcrumbs.

tokens.name: secondary-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind secondary text: the Tutorial badge and a project's status.

tokens.name: link-color
tokens.usage: Links in running text, always underlined.

tokens.name: focus-color
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: a 2px outline, 2px away from the element.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The page, the header and the footer.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and the copy button of a code block.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Tab strips and quiet panels.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Table headings and the Note callout.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: A control under the pointer, and the pressed button of the theme toggle.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks and inline code.

tokens.name: header-background
tokens.usage: The sticky header: the same as the page, and set apart by `header-border`.

tokens.name: header-border
tokens.usage: The hairline under the header.

tokens.name: admin-header-background
tokens.usage: The header of the website's admin area, with `text-on-dark`.

tokens.name: text-color
tokens.usage: Interface text and labels, and the current link.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Headings.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Running text.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, descriptions, and the links of the navigation and the footer.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Metadata: the ledger margin, dates, counts and labels.

tokens.name: text-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on `admin-header-background` and `notification-badge`.

tokens.name: text-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on a `primary-color` fill. Never white.

tokens.name: border-color
tokens.usage: Borders and dividers: cards, ledger rows, tables and the footer.

tokens.name: border-color-light
tokens.usage: Quiet borders, such as between the rows of an admin table.

tokens.name: border-color-muted
tokens.usage: Sidebar rules, and the dots of the dot grid.

tokens.name: border-color-fieldset
tokens.usage: The border of a fieldset.

tokens.name: border-color-input
tokens.usage: The border of an input, a select, a textarea and a secondary button.

tokens.name: border-color-strong
tokens.usage: The copy button of a code block, and page numbers under the pointer.

tokens.name: border-color-tree
tokens.usage: The guide line of a nested list of topics.

tokens.name: margin-rule-color
tokens.usage: The ledger's margin rule: `primary-color` at 70 % opacity.

tokens.name: success-color
tokens.usage: Success, as text, and the Tip callout. Always with words.

tokens.name: success-background
tokens.usage: Behind a success message and the Tip callout.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: The border of a success message.

tokens.name: danger-color
tokens.usage: Errors, as text: an error message, the border of an invalid field and the Caution callout. Always with words.

tokens.name: danger-background
tokens.usage: Behind an error message and the Caution callout.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: The border of an error message.

tokens.name: notification-badge
tokens.usage: The count on the website's notification bell, with `text-on-dark`.

tokens.name: warning-color
tokens.usage: A warning, as text outside a banner. Always with words.

tokens.name: info-color
tokens.usage: Neutral information, as text.

tokens.name: banner-info-background
tokens.usage: Behind an info banner.

tokens.name: banner-info-color
tokens.usage: The text of an info banner.

tokens.name: banner-warning-background
tokens.usage: Behind a warning banner and the Warning callout.

tokens.name: banner-warning-color
tokens.usage: The text of a warning banner, and the Warning callout.

tokens.name: banner-error-background
tokens.usage: Behind an error banner.

tokens.name: banner-error-color
tokens.usage: The text of an error banner.

tokens.name: banner-success-background
tokens.usage: Behind a success banner.

tokens.name: banner-success-color
tokens.usage: The text of a success banner.

tokens.name: tag-background-hover
tokens.usage: A tag under the pointer in the website's admin area.

tokens.name: image-placeholder-start
tokens.usage: One end of the placeholder shown while an image loads.

tokens.name: image-placeholder-end
tokens.usage: The other end of the placeholder shown while an image loads.

tokens.name: resource-icon-color
tokens.usage: The icon beside a reference or a further-reading link.

tokens.name: resource-kind-color
tokens.usage: The kind of a reference, such as PDF or Video.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords in code.

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Functions and methods in code.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings in code.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Numbers and constants in code.

tokens.name: code-type
tokens.usage: Types and classes in code.

tokens.name: code-builtin
tokens.usage: Built-in names in code.

tokens.name: code-tag
tokens.usage: Tags in markup.

tokens.name: code-property
tokens.usage: Properties and attributes in code.

tokens.name: code-parameter
tokens.usage: Parameters in code.

tokens.name: code-operator
tokens.usage: Operators in code.

tokens.name: code-punctuation
tokens.usage: Punctuation in code.

tokens.name: code-escape
tokens.usage: Escapes and regular expressions in code.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments in code.

tokens.name: font-display
tokens.usage: The logo, and brand moments: hero lines, section titles, Article titles and empty states.

tokens.name: font-ui
tokens.usage: The interface: headings, navigation, buttons, labels, forms and tables.

tokens.name: font-serif
tokens.usage: Running text: articles, posts, summaries and ledes.

tokens.name: font-mono
tokens.usage: Code, and small metadata: dates, counts, series parts and labels.

tokens.name: font-size-xs
tokens.usage: Mono metadata and labels.

tokens.name: font-size-sm
tokens.usage: Small interface text, captions and code.

tokens.name: font-size-base
tokens.usage: Interface text.

tokens.name: font-size-lg
tokens.usage: Running text and ledes.

tokens.name: font-size-xl
tokens.usage: Level 3 headings, and card titles.

tokens.name: font-size-2xl
tokens.usage: Level 2 headings, and the line of an empty state.

tokens.name: font-size-3xl
tokens.usage: Level 1 headings.

tokens.name: font-size-display
tokens.usage: Playfair Display hero lines and section titles.

tokens.name: line-height-tight
tokens.usage: Headings.

tokens.name: line-height-base
tokens.usage: Interface text.

tokens.name: line-height-reading
tokens.usage: Running text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside pills and badges, and between a heading and its # link.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between the items of a row of pills, buttons or page numbers.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between the fields of a form, and inside small controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The smallest page gutter, and the space between a title and its lede.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between the entries of a carousel, and the padding of a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The padding above and below a ledger row, and the gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups, such as the columns of the footer, and under a section head.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Above the body of a Post or an Article, and the largest page gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between the sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Above related items at the end of a page.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Above and below the head of a page on a large screen.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code, page numbers and the buttons inside the theme toggle.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, code blocks, callouts and the theme toggle.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Pictures in a grid.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and their covers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Topic pills, badges and a project's status.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: A small raised control.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus and dropdowns.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: A dialog. Use space, then a border, before a shadow.

tokens.name: transition-fast
tokens.usage: A colour change under the pointer, and the arrow of a link that moves.

tokens.name: transition-base
tokens.usage: The theme toggle, the table of contents and a heading's # link.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: Above its siblings, such as the copy button of a code block.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus inside the header.

tokens.name: z-banner
tokens.usage: The sticky stack of banners, below the header.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: The sticky header.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: A dialog, above everything.

tokens.name: content-max-width
tokens.usage: The width of the header, the footer and the content of a page.

tokens.name: layout-max-width
tokens.usage: The width of narrower pages, such as a project or the admin area.

tokens.name: page-gutter
tokens.usage: The space at each side of a page. Never less than 16px.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The widest a block of running text gets.

tokens.name: ledger-margin-width
tokens.usage: The ledger's margin column, left of the rule.

tokens.name: ledger-gap
tokens.usage: The space at each side of the ledger's margin rule.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: Below it, the navigation links get a row of their own and the footer's columns wrap. Media queries cannot read custom properties, so copy the value.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Below it, the ledger stacks: the margin moves above the content. Media queries cannot read custom properties, so copy the value.
